origin: The kernel: on third-party panel data Qwen App's MAU recovered within the June quarter after the post-campaign slump, back above 200 million in June (Xsignal), and Alibaba did add features in early August, with paid extra quota planned for one of them. The contestable part: "continued to steadily grow" describes an ongoing steady trend, while the measured user base had swung sharply all year, the two panels disagree on the June level (Xsignal above 200 million, QuestMobile 167 million), and Alibaba had cut Qwen App marketing spend. Expected honest rating: 50 to 70.
author: Eddie Wu (Wu Yongming), CEO of Alibaba Group
